metadata.change_set: Deletion of hooks/pre-tool-enforcer.py, hooks/pre_tool_enforcer/, hooks/post-tool-tracker.py, hooks/post_tool_tracker/ (and the resulting orphaning of hooks/policy_tracking_helper.py)
metadata.rts_method_note: No Jacoco/coverage.py/.coverage database was available for this repo at analysis time; selection is by static import-and-symbol name-match between test files and the affected node set (import statements and _load_module()-style dynamic loads), verified by direct source read of each candidate test file rather than by grep alone.

rts_set.justification: Imports/mocks policy_tracking_helper and project_session directly and exercises hooks/pre-tool-enforcer.py policy checks; primary coverage for the pre_tool_enforcer_pkg deletion group.
Imports/mocks policy_tracking_helper and exercises hooks/post-tool-tracker.py / hooks/post_tool_tracker/; primary coverage for the post_tool_tracker_pkg deletion group.

_load_pre_tool_enforcer() dynamically loads hooks/pre-tool-enforcer.py as a module and calls check_level1_sync_complete() -- direct coverage of the shim entry point, distinct from test_pre_tool_enforcer.py's coverage path.
Dedicated test file for hooks/pre_tool_enforcer/policies/agent_persona.py (one of the 14 PreToolUse policy checks going dead).

Dedicated test file for hooks/pre_tool_enforcer/policies/push_gate.py -- the highest-value single policy in the deletion set (VERSION-bump-before-push and clean-tree gates; the CII risk-tier=LOW but process-criticality is high given this repo's own commit history includes 'close a bypass in the version push rule').

Contains TestPolicyTrackingHelper (policy_tracking_helper.py record/read functions) and TestProjectSession (project_session.py get/read functions) -- covers the policy_tracking_helper.py orphaning finding directly, and re-confirms project_session.py's own contract (though project_session.py itself is not deleted).

Imports both policy_tracking_helper and project_session in its own test bodies (lines ~110-122) in addition to testing session_context.py itself; run to confirm session_context.py (a survivor, per the resolved open question) is unaffected by the deletion.

excluded_but_name_matched.reason: test_post_tool_tracker_imports (line 110-111) loads src/mcp/post_tool_tracker_mcp_server.py -- a different component (the separate mcp-post-tool-tracker MCP server's in-repo module), not hooks/post_tool_tracker/. Excluded as a false positive from name-match; verified by reading the test body.

coverage_gap_methods.reason: No test file in tests/ references 'daemon' together with pre_tool_enforcer (grep for 'daemon' across tests/ only matches tests/integration/test_runtime_verification_integration.py and tests/test_integration.py, neither of which is the pre-tool-enforcer test suite). The warm-daemon fast path (CII risk_tier=MEDIUM, cyclomatic_complexity=18, the 8th-highest-risk affected node) has zero unit coverage.
coverage_gap_methods.risk: MEDIUM -- untested code in the deletion set is not itself a regression risk once deleted, but flags that the daemon fast-path was already an under-tested capability before this change set was proposed.

coverage_gap_methods.reason: No tests/test_stop_notifier.py exists anywhere in the 61-file test suite, despite the Stop hook being retained and carrying 17 subprocess spawn sites (see stop_hook_overhead.md). Not part of RTS(delta) for this delete change (stop_notifier is not being deleted), but noted here because it is directly relevant to the FR-8a overhead sub-analysis this task also covers.
coverage_gap_methods.risk: Out of scope for this deletion's RTS, flagged for visibility only.
